artworks.title: The Evening Hour
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with cows standing by a tranquil body of water. The sky is partly cloudy with a few birds flying in the distance. The landscape is detailed with fine lines, showcasing the textures of the cows, trees, and grass. The color palette is monochrome with various shades of grey. Rolling hills and trees can be seen in the background.

artworks.title: Canyon, No. III
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image: 298 x 127 mm
sheet 381 x 260 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with tall buildings on both sides, creating a narrow corridor effect. The horizon line is obscured by the tall buildings. In the distance, there is a smaller, brighter building. The buildings are detailed with fine lines and cross-hatching. The color palette is monochrome, using shades of black and white to accentuate contrast and depth. Numerous figures fill the street, creating a bustling scene.

artworks.title: Statue of Liberty
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a stylized depiction of the Statue of Liberty from a close perspective to the waterline. The horizon is positioned above the middle of the composition, with the statue's silhouette prominently featured against the sky. The artwork appears to use block printing or screen printing techniques, with broad, flat areas of color defining shapes and outlines. The color scheme includes muted shades of green, yellow, blue, and brown, creating a harmonious, vintage poster-like look. Simplified shapes suggesting water and a ship are visible in the foreground, while the statue stands tall against the open sky, with an abstract treatment of negative space and form around it.

artworks.title: Thinking It Over
artworks.dimensions:
image: 353 x 243 mm
sheet:  486 x 357 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly man standing by a cluttered workbench in a dimly lit workshop. He has a full white beard and hair, is dressed in a dark apron over a shirt, and appears contemplative. Various tools and papers are on the workbench, with some tools hanging on the walls in the background. A window to the left brings light into the room.

artworks.title: New York Public Library
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image displays a street scene featuring the New York Public Library from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is high, aligned with the upper edge of the library building. The building is adorned with large windows and columns, catching sunlight that casts soft shadows. An American flag flutters on a pole to the right of the image. The brushstrokes create an impressionistic quality. The color palette is warm and inviting, with soft pastels dominating the composition - light blues, grays, tans, and pops of red and green. Several figures, including an adult and a child, stroll on the sidewalk. A street lamp and a parked vehicle are visible to the left of the building. In the distance, other individuals are scattered near the building's façade.

artworks.title: The Hudson from Riverside Drive
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with three children in colorful garments lounging on a grassy slope under a leafy tree. A wooden staircase leads down to the riverbank. The background features a calm river meeting distant land with soft blues suggesting hills or low mountains. The sky shows a blend of warm peachy orange colors, reflecting on the water. The painting style is soft and stylized, typical of early 20th-century illustration, with a harmonious color palette of greens, oranges, and blues.

artworks.title: St. Paul's Chapel
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a view of St. Paul's Chapel from a slightly upward angle, with the chapel standing out in the scene. Buildings surround the chapel, indicating an urban setting. The chapel's steeple is visible against a sky with soft blue hues and pastel clouds. Modern buildings in muted orange, yellow, and blue colors are seen behind the chapel. Close to the viewer, rows of gravestones are present, with tree shadows framing the scene on the right. The color palette includes earth tones, pastels, and hints of vibrant colors, creating a nostalgic and peaceful atmosphere. The brushstrokes give the scene a painterly and charming style.

artworks.title: The Woolworth Building from the Ferry
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a body of water with a small steam-powered vessel creating waves. In the background, there is a city skyline with buildings, including the Woolworth Building. The sky is pastel blue with a large, diffuse cloud.

artworks.title: New York from the 34th Street Ferry
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image features a view of New York City skyline from a ferry on 34th Street. The skyline includes mid-sized buildings leading up to a tower with a pointed spire. The painting uses soft, impressionistic brushstrokes to convey the scene with gentle transitions and define architectural features subtly. The color palette consists of soft pastel hues like blues, creamy yellows, and hints of reds and browns, creating a mellow atmosphere. In the water, there are boats including a small motorboat and a sailboat. The skyline in the distance is softly blurred.

artworks.title: The Metropolitan Tower on A Summer Evening
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows the Metropolitan Tower against a summer evening sky. The view is from the ground looking slightly upward, capturing the tower and its surroundings. In the foreground, there are green foliage and clusters of flowers on the left. Beyond the foliage, there are silhouettes of people and a horse-drawn carriage on the street. The tall tower with glowing windows stands in the center, beyond the trees. The horizon is at the lower third, where trees and lampposts meet the tower's base. The sky transitions from orange near the horizon to blue higher up. The brushwork combines outlines and washes of color. The color palette includes warm and cool tones, with earthy greens and browns balancing the cooler blues and pastels of the sky.

artworks.title: The Cathedral of St. John the Divine from Morningside Park
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of the Cathedral of St. John the Divine in the distance. The horizon line is high with the cathedral dominating the upper portion. The painting uses soft, impressionistic brushstrokes to depict the scene. The color palette is earthy and warm with browns, greens, pinks, and blues. In the foreground, children in bright pastel clothing are playing on a green lawn. The middle section features trees, shrubs, and rocky terrain leading to the cathedral.

artworks.title: The Singer Building from Brooklyn Bridge
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows the city skyline with a focus on the Singer Building from the Brooklyn Bridge. The skyscraper stands out against the horizon, with warm skies transitioning from yellows to oranges. Urban buildings dot the horizon, suggesting city life. The brushstrokes are stylized and impressionistic, with simplified forms and smooth lines creating a harmonious composition. The color palette includes earthy tones for the architecture and pastels for the sky, providing a peaceful backdrop to the urban landscape.

artworks.title: Washington Arch at Winter Twilight
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows the view through the Washington Arch at twilight in winter. The arch is depicted in a warm tone with detailed carvings, standing out in the composition. A woman in a brown coat and colorful hat is walking towards the viewer, with a horse-drawn cart passing under the arch. In the distance, a building with a tall tower and a lit beacon is visible against a peach-colored sky. The brushstrokes give a sense of fluidity, and the color palette includes cool blues and grays for the snow and arch, contrasting with the warm tones of the sunset.

artworks.title: Hotel Plaza from Central Park
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a view of Central Park, featuring a pair of swans floating on a calm body of water surrounded by lush greenery. The brushstrokes are soft and impressionistic, blending colors to create a peaceful scene. In the background, the Hotel Plaza stands tall amidst green trees. The color palette includes greens, light blues, earthy browns, and soft pastels, contributing to the tranquil ambiance.

artworks.title: The Elevated Railroad at 110th Street
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a view from the ground looking up towards an elevated railroad at 110th Street. The horizon is obscured by the railroad's structure and tall trees alongside it. In the distance, the elevated track is visible with a passing train. Tall trees frame the view, depicted with quick brushstrokes. A staircase is partially visible with a few figures on it. The color palette includes muted greens and browns for trees and the ground, contrasted with reddish-orange and brown tones of the elevated structure and distant buildings.

artworks.title: Trinity Church and Wall Street
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows Trinity Church and Wall Street from a street-level perspective. The church's spire stands tall in the distance, framed by surrounding buildings. There are contrasting shaded and sunlit areas, with vivid red walls and an American flag standing out. The scene features a bustling urban street with people, a horse-drawn carriage, and a red streetcar. The style resembles early 20th-century illustrations with bold brushstrokes and a limited color palette of earthy tones, reds, and blues accented with black outlines.

artworks.description: The image features a bottle labeled "Poni Bare" near a fabric-draped surface. There are fruits such as a pear, an apple, and another fruit to the right. The color palette is monochrome with shades of black, white, and gray. The bottle is in the foreground on the left side, surrounded by the fruits. The drapery serves as the background. In the upper background, a figure is reclining, visible between grapevines.

artworks.title: Pouring Steel In Moulds
artworks.dimensions:
image:  559 x 442 mm
sheet:  619 x 497 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an industrial scene inside a large factory or foundry. The artwork depicts an interior space filled with heavy machinery. Prominently in the image is an enormous ladle or crucible suspended from the ceiling by a crane, pouring molten material. The light from the molten substance illuminates the dark industrial setting, casting dramatic shadows across the scene. The structure of the space is defined by robust beams and panels. Rails are visible on the ground leading to a large container or cart positioned to capture the molten material. The drawing has a rich texture, likely created through careful shading and detailed lines.

artworks.title: Steel Being Poured Into Open Hearth Furnace
artworks.dimensions:
image: 444 x 559 mm
sheet: 520 x 660 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting an industrial scene. The image shows the interior of a factory or foundry where a large cylindrical metal object is being worked on. Flames and heavy smoke dominate the environment, indicating intense heat and activity related to smelting or metalworking. The scene is illuminated by the bright glow of the fire, creating dramatic shadows and highlights. Industrial machinery and structures, such as beams and cranes, are visible. The artist employs strong contrasts and dynamic lines to convey the intense, energetic atmosphere common in a steel mill or similar industrial facility.

artworks.title: Among the Ice Floes
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape with ships anchored in icy waters. The horizon is low with towering icebergs creating a boundary between the sky and water. The style appears to be an etching with fine lines outlining the ships and ice. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. Patches of ice float in the water, while ships are seen in the distance across ice and water.

artworks.title: Untitled (Morning Delivery)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 284 x 356 mm
sheet: 390 x 454 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with hills in the background and a sky above. The artwork uses distinct, softly rounded forms and textures. The color palette consists of shades of gray, black, and white. In the foreground, there are figures sitting beside a fence and a person working on a vehicle. In the middle ground, there are small buildings with one centrally located. In the background, there is a taller, silo-like building among rolling hills. A telephone pole with a light fixture is also visible in the scene.

artworks.title: Keying Up: The Court Jester
artworks.dimensions:
image: 152 x 92 mm
primary sheet: 235 x 162 mm
secondary sheet: 291 x 245 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a person dressed in a jester's attire. The person is standing, holding an object that resembles a puppet or a mask. The person's face has exaggerated features, with a pronounced nose and a closed-mouth grin. They wear a jester's cap and outfit, including a patterned shirt with ruffles at the cuffs, and pants with a zig-zag hem. A patterned garment hangs from the left arm. The figure stands on a textured floor, with part of a decorative column visible on the left. The background is dark, contrasting with the lighter tones of the clothing. The image is signed "W.M. Chase" in the lower left corner.

artworks.title: A Pastoral
artworks.dimensions:
image: 305 x 149 mm
sheet:  362 x 184 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on the ground, depicted from the waist up. This individual is leaning slightly forward, with their head turned to the side and their eyes closed or looking down. They have short, curly hair, possibly styled back, a straight nose, and closed lips. The person wears a sleeveless tunic, holding a shepherd's crook in one hand. Sheep and lambs are around them, and the background includes a lightly sketched landscape with trees and a flock of sheep grazing in the distance.
